name: Kagurazaka Wataru
source:
Hobby: Gaming
Favorite Food: Yakiniku

Understands his own appeal and uses it to his advantage, playing the cute cuddly puppy character for the female guests. Cunning and clever, he is generally calculating, but a privileged boy at heart, he will sometimes come off as soft.
